subject: maths
question: At what annual rate (rounded off to the nearest integer) of simple interest will a sum of money become five times its initial value in 18 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest (S.I) = 4 × Principal (P)

Time = 18 years

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

Where, P = principal ; R = rate ; T = time
